heading: INT. COUNTY PAROLE OFFICE - WAITING AREA - MORNING

units.text: INT. COUNTY PAROLE OFFICE - WAITING AREA - MORNING
Plastic chairs bolted in rows.
A water cooler gurgles.
Behind the glass, a clerk types, never looking up.
Big Dave, 50s, broad, in a suit that fits like it was lent to him, sits with his hands folded.
Beside him, Jen Park, 40s, parole officer, flips through a file with her thumb.
Everybody sign the sheet. Even if you've signed it before. Especially if you've signed it before.
units.name: JEN
paren: to the room, not looking up

units.text: Two teenagers by the vending machine laugh at something on a phone.
A man with a toddler on his knee shushes the child, who cries anyway.
I've been out eleven months. I've been on time every Tuesday. Every Tuesday, Jen.
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: I know.
units.name: JEN

units.text: Then why am I looking at a new condition on my own paper?
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: Dave. Sit.
units.name: JEN

units.text: I did what you said. I took the job. I stayed at Mo's place. I stayed away from the old crowd.
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: Mo, 30s, in the next chair over with a hi-vis vest in her lap, stares at the floor.
Don't drag me into this.
units.name: MO

units.text: You're the one who said they'd write the letter.
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: I said I'd think about it.
units.name: MO

units.text: Folks, give us a minute. Please.
units.name: JEN

units.text: The two teenagers drift off down the hall.
The man with the toddler picks up the child and leaves.
The clerk behind the glass finally looks up.
You want to tell me who made the call?
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: No.
units.name: JEN

units.text: Somebody called. Somebody told you where I was on the fourteenth.
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: Dave, I can't discuss it here.
units.name: JEN

units.text: Then where?
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: Jen and Big Dave collide and both stumble into the water cooler.
The jug SLOSHES and tips.
Mo jumps up and the three of them freeze.
It was me.
units.name: MO

units.text: Silence.
The cooler glugs once, and stops.
Say that again.
units.name: BIG DAVE

units.text: You said if I told you, he would only get a warning.
units.name: MO

units.text: God help me.
units.name: JEN

units.text: Big Dave sits.
Slowly, like a man lowering something heavy.
The clerk behind the glass quietly turns off her screen.
